name: session-usage
description: Claude ✻ gets more and more nervous as your 5h session is used up

showResetIn.title: Time until reset
showResetIn.description: Show how long until the 5h session resets, e.g. ↻ 1h52.

showRate.title: Usage rate
showRate.description: Show how fast the 5h session is being used, in % per hour, e.g. +18%/h. Appears after 5 minutes of readings.

showSessionTime.title: Session duration
showSessionTime.description: Show how long this Claude Code session has been running, e.g. sess 2h05.
